records.finding: The Insights 10000-row cap silently truncated a failure storm's events — a smaller dollar figure with no disclosure.
records.evidence: limit 10000 in the query, no count check on Complete.
records.reason: A full 10000-row result errors loudly telling the caller to narrow the window; over-triggering on exactly-10k is the honest side.

records.finding: start=lastTS+1 dropped entries sharing a cut page's final nanosecond.
records.evidence: The pre-fix comment admitted the skip.
records.reason: Pager re-requests the boundary ns with a carry-grown limit and (ns,line) de-dup; single-ns overflow fails loudly. Examiner probed with adversarial same-ns bursts, stuck servers, and identical-line duplicates (Loki's own ingest dedup makes the key exact): no loss, no dup, guaranteed termination.

records.finding: Floored exclusive latest_time excluded in-window events.
records.evidence: Contrast with cwinsights' widened bounds in the same diff.
records.reason: Both bounds widen a second; memq re-applies the exact half-open window, so widening cannot over-count.

records.finding: Parse failure and marker absence shared one silent skip.
records.reason: The trade is now stated explicitly in the code (shared groups legitimately carry EMF metric records and foreign lines; LocalStack ignores the pushdown); examiner judged the accepted-trade disposition sound.

records.finding: A marked line without an amount parsed as $0 into sums.
records.reason: Loud error + test; all three exporters write the amount unconditionally so no legitimate line is refused (examiner verified all three write sites).

records.finding: Arbitrary result strings were silently invisible to outcome filters.
records.reason: biz.Result.Valid() rejection + test; the valid set covers everything exporters ship.
